name: AWS CloudTrail - EC2 Instance Changes

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail (*Instances)
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name
| where event_name in ("RunInstances","RebootInstances","StartInstances","StopInstances","TerminateInstances")
// EoQ

description: Monitor for AWS API calls being performed to create, terminate, start, stop, or reboot an EC2 instance.
